title: Route SLI Drift Explorer — streaming vs non-streaming snapshots and alerting
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: build a focused explorer and alerting workflow to detect SLI drift across model routes with explicit streaming vs non-streaming decompositions. This ticket covers dashboard surface, snapshotting cadence, trace-linking hooks for tailcases, and an initial alerting policy prototype. Background: we currently surface route-level percentiles but lack a simple way to compare distribution shifts between streaming and blocking IO modes per model route or to snapshot state for offline investigation. The explorer should make it easy to baseline p50/p95/p99 over windows, compare current vs baseline, and surface correlated error/trace fingerprints for fast RCA.
acceptance_criteria: Explorer UI that lists model routes and shows p50/p95/p99 for the last 5m/1h/24h with a streaming vs non-streaming toggle
Snapshot API that can capture current percentile vector for a route (p50,p95,p99, tail-count) and store 7-day history for drift comparisons
Trace hooks: clicking any percentiles in the explorer links to up to 5 representative traces (sampling by latency buckets) and preserves streaming/non-streaming context
Alerting prototype: an SLI-drift rule that triggers when p95 deviates >20% vs 24h baseline for two consecutive 5m windows — includes runbook and triangulation pointers
Telemetry coverage: metrics and logs pipeline captures io_mode dimension (streaming|blocking), model_family, route, request_shape; queries for p50/p95/p99 validated against raw traces
tasks: Define telemetry schema changes and add io_mode tag to request latency metric
Author Prometheus/ClickHouse query templates for percentile snapshots + delta calculations
Backend: implement snapshot API and 7-day retention table
Frontend: explorer table + percentile sparklines + streaming toggle
Trace linking: add trace_id samples for percentile buckets and surface in UI
Alerting: create prototype alert rule and test it in staging with synthetic drift
Docs: add runbook and observability playbook entries linking to dashboard and traces
QA: validate sampling correctness and compare snapshots against raw trace-derived quantiles
telemetry_queries: -- ClickHouse example: SELECT route, io_mode, quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(latency_ms) AS q FROM requests WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY route, io_mode
-- Prometheus histogram approach: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, io_mode))
-- Delta calc (p95 drift): p95_now = quantile(0.95, latencies_last5m); p95_baseline = quantile(0.95, latencies_24h_before); drift = (p95_now - p95_baseline) / p95_baseline
-- Trace selection: SELECT trace_id FROM requests WHERE route = 'X' AND io_mode = 'streaming' AND latency_ms >= (SELECT quantile(0.95, latency_ms) FROM requests WHERE ... ) LIMIT 5
